description: The contract the synthetic candles from tools.make_sample_data run under, so the smoke path and the test suite exercise the real research entrypoints instead of a bypass. It seals at the same instant as btc-usdt-1h-gen1 and resolves to the same kind of boundary, but its scope is the synthetic series, which is what makes it a different contract: neither can be applied to the other's data, and no run under this one is comparable with a run under that one. Nothing measured under this contract is a research result - the series is a random walk, not a market.
